Package org.cyborgcats.vision

package org.cyborgcats.vision
  • Class
    Description
    AprilTag
    A single AprilTag's fiducial ID and its known field-relative pose, as defined by the current AprilTagField layout.
    AprilTagDetection
    A single AprilTag detection: fiducial ID and its four corner points in image space, ordered as PhotonVision/AprilTag reports them (starting at the corner nearest the tag's bottom-left, counter-clockwise).
    AprilTagDetections
    A batch of AprilTagDetections from a single camera frame, with the ability to flatten itself into the raw int[]/float[] arrays the native solvePnP/ solveTrig JNI calls expect.
    AprilTagEstimate
    A resolved AprilTag pose estimate from a single native solve: the best (and, when ambiguous, alternate) camera pose candidate, associated reprojection errors, and the tags that contributed to it.
    AprilTagEstimator
    Wraps the native AprilTag pose-solve JNI bindings, translating between this package's Java types and AprilTagEstimatorJNI.
    AprilTagField
    Global holder for the game's AprilTagFieldLayout.
    AprilTagTarget
    Per-tag detail for a single AprilTag that contributed to an AprilTagEstimate: its known field pose, detected image corners, angular offsets, and both pose-solve candidates for this tag alone.
    AtlasVisionTarget
    Raw wire-format mirror of Atlas's VisionTarget struct (one AprilTag detection: a fiducial id and its four image-space corners, flattened to 8 floats).
    AtlasVisionTargets
    Raw wire-format mirror of Atlas's VisionTargets struct (one camera frame's worth of detections): a capture timestamp and up to AtlasVisionTargets.kMaxTargets AtlasVisionTarget slots, with count recording how many are actually populated.
    CameraMatrix
    Pinhole camera intrinsics: focal lengths and principal point, in pixels.
    CameraResolution
    Camera image resolution, in pixels.
    DistortionCoefficients
    OpenCV rational-model lens distortion coefficients: k1-k6 are radial distortion terms and p1/p2 are tangential distortion terms.
    VisionMeasurment
    A single vision-based robot pose measurement, ready to feed into a pose estimator.
    VisionResult
    A vision measurement paired with the number of tags that contributed to it.
    VisionStdDevs
    Interpolated vision measurement standard deviations, keyed by total tag area.
